_comment: Model descriptions Jev chooses between (policy.models[*].good_at/weak_at/cost). Jev never sees names or numbers; these words are the whole basis of its pick. Sources: Artificial Analysis API per-task columns (hard reasoning, terminal/agentic, coding, long context, speed) at the effort each model really runs here, joined with OpenRouter price/window, plus warslop gates of 2026-10-20/21. Writing and Indonesian quality are not ranked (every model does them); small talk and summaries go to the free pool in the app. Cost words: OpenCode Go models are included in a flat subscription; OpenRouter models are pay per use.

ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.good_at: very fast answers, long documents and long conversations (the best long-context reasoning), everyday coding and tool use, solid reasoning
ocgoa/opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash.weak_at: the toughest multi-step tool tasks, where the 1017 build and glm are stronger

ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.good_at: coding (the best coding-index score among the cheap models) and general tasks, reads images
ocgoa/opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash.weak_at: long multi-step tool tasks and the hardest reasoning; moderate speed

ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail
ocgob/opencode-go/gpt-6-luna.weak_at: tool use (at the effort it runs here it barely completes terminal tasks), hard reasoning and coding; do not choose it for these

ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging, data work and long multi-step tool use (top tier on terminal-task and coding benchmarks), solid hard reasoning, reads images; moderate speed
ocgob/opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash.weak_at: the fastest answers (it thinks before it answers)

ocpv/opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-fre.good_at: simple requests when nothing else answers
ocpv/opencode-go/longcat-2.5-preview-fre.weak_at: very slow to start answering; weak at reasoning and tools

ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.good_at: simple factual questions and light tasks; reads images
ocgob/opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash.weak_at: coding, tool use and hard reasoning (clearly behind the others); slow to start

openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.good_at: coding, debugging, data work and long multi-step tool use (top tier on terminal-task and coding benchmarks), solid hard reasoning, reads images; quick to start
openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.weak_at: the fastest answers (it thinks before it answers)

openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail
openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.weak_at: tool use and hard reasoning at the effort it runs here (well below the deepseek and glm models); the most expensive option
openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5.cost: pay per use, the most expensive option here

openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.good_at: a different vendor as a fallback when the others fail
openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna.weak_at: tool use, hard reasoning and coding at the effort it runs here; do not choose it for these

ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use; reads images; summaries of long text
ocpv/opencode-go/minimax-m3.1-flash-free.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.good_at: small talk, greetings, short factual answers and summaries of short or medium text; the fastest to answer
ocpv/opencode-go/beam-free.weak_at: tool use, code and hard reasoning (nearly fails terminal tasks)

openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.good_at: the strongest free option at hard reasoning, coding and multi-step tool use; reads images; summaries of long text
openrouter/minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash:fr.weak_at: sometimes mixes Chinese words into Indonesian answers

openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.good_at: following instructions exactly, summaries, short factual answers and simple code in clean Indonesian
openrouter/nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-.weak_at: hard reasoning, long tool tasks and code (the weakest free option there); can be slow on long answers

openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.good_at: the strongest all-rounder here: hard reasoning and maths, difficult coding, long multi-step tool and terminal tasks, long documents; still fast; reads images
openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-.weak_at: pay per use, so only when the included models are not enough

openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.good_at: fast, cheap tool use and long documents (top-tier terminal-task and long-context results for its price), everyday coding and reasoning
openrouter/inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash.weak_at: does not read images; shorter memory (about a quarter of a million tokens)
